test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"mixed".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• "Mixed" means to combine different things together.
 
• The sentence implies that something is being combined or blended together.
 
• The other options do not make sense in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sliced** means to cut something into thin pieces.
 
• **Diced **means to cut something into small cubes.
 
• **Rotated **means to turn something around a central point.
